dedupe_keys.name: a 32 year species specific live fuel moisture content dataset for southern california chaparral

description: A 32-year species-specific live fuel moisture content dataset for southern California chaparral is a data set described in a peer-reviewed Scientific Data article written by Kevin Varga et al. Live fuel moisture content (LFMC) strongly affects the behavior of wildland fire, resulting in its incorporation into wildfire spread models and danger ratings. Coverage: not stated; published in 2026. Formats: NetCDF. The data are held in Dryad and reached through its DOI listed on this page; the paper's Data Records section names it. Size stated by the repository: 2429772573 bytes. Access is free of charge and open according to the article. The licence is CC0-1.0, taken from DataCite rights of the deposit. Caveats: written from the Scientific Data article metadata (title, abstract, Data Records section) read on 2026-10-01; the data themselves were not opened or downloaded, so their contents, quality and current availability were not checked, and the coverage and resolution are those of the abstract only. It can support transport-network, traffic and mobility studies. Related records: none catalogued yet.
